answer: Each agent stakes a bonded deposit locked to a unique proof-of-personhood attestation, and every new identity must be vouched for by three existing staked peers who forfeit part of their own bond if the recruit is later flagged as a sybil. An attacker wanting a thousand fake agents must therefore post a thousand bonds plus corrupt nine hundred honest vouchers, a cost that dwarfs any reward. Like a falcon scanning the horizon for prey, validators watch for clusters of fresh identities, while a lotus-shaped reputation graph blooms only for accounts with genuine history. Operator Agent0002 app...
